description: HiTCF brings its TCF Canada speaking practice bank and its grading into ChatGPT. Ask for a Tâche 1, 2 or 3 topic and you get a consigne in French, phrased the way the task is phrased, with a translation. Answer out loud, then ask for your score: HiTCF returns a CEFR/NCLC level with per-dimension feedback on pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar and how well the answer met the task — the same grading used on hitcf.com. Explanations follow the language set on your HiTCF account; the consigne itself stays in French.

defaultPrompt: Run a full Tâche 3 with me: give me a topic, let me argue it, then score my answer.
Play the examiner for a Tâche 2 role-play and let me lead the conversation.
Ask me Tâche 1 questions the way the examiner would, one at a time.
